_doc: Light inside buildings (EnvironmentController, PoiBuilder's interior probes; ADR-0050). Each room rectangle's reflection probe replaces the sky's ambient with a flat fill, because SDFGI leaves rooms near black. By day the fill is day_fill of day_color, dimmed by overcast_dim under full cloud; at night it is night_share of the outdoor night's ambient, in its colour (the moon's or the Hum's, through the windows). Each room gets a share of that by its daylight (PoiBuilder.daylight_ratio: square metres of outside doors and windows per square metre of floor, with shut doors and boarded windows counted at a fraction): daylight_min_share with none (a cellar), all of it from daylight_full_ratio up. No room goes below night_floor, so a dark room still shows its shapes against what a lamp lights. A lightning flash adds flash_share of its fill. While the eye is inside a room the exposure opens by exposure_day (by day) or exposure_night (at night), eased over adapt_seconds: the doorway blooms a little and the room reads, as an eye adapts.
